profile.headline: Master's in Computational Design and Manufacturing at CMU
profile.summary: I am a graduate student at Carnegie Mellon University pursuing Master's in Computational Design and Manufacturing. I wish to be an integral part in computational engineering domain.  My research at Carnegie Mellon University focus on acquiring problem solving skills with, learning new algorithms and building tools for modern CAD and CAE.

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Graduate Teaching Assistant for Computer Aided Design course.

positions.title: Software Integrity Intern
positions.description:
• Augmented the automation suite for product testing by creating new tcl/tk scripts to check the integrity of various tools for different HyperMesh Solver interfaces (RADIOSS, Optistruct, Nastran) in terms of functionality and performance
• Performed different types of tests such as unit, integrated and regression to identify software bugs

positions.title: CAE Engineer
positions.description:
Worked as CAE Engineer in the offshore vehicular program development team for Jaguar and Land Rover cars (JLR) at Tata Technologies. Performed and executed NVH analyses such as structural and vibrational analyses for full body vehicle.  Successfully delivered the results to the client (JLR) and recommended design solutions based on the results of the analyses. Concurrently, I actively engaged in customization of Finite Element Analysis software to enhance the efficiency of various CAE process.

Published a total of 3 paper while working with the company - 2 papers in Altair Conference and 1 paper in International Journal of Latest Technology in Engineering and Management.

Skills gained: 
FEA Softwares: HyperWorks, ANSA
Solvers: Nastran, Optistruct
Programming: Tcl/Tk (customization of CAE Softwares)

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
Worked for the software development group at Altair. I automated the entire process of composite modeling used extensively in aerospace industry. Also, I developed a comprehensive search tool for entire Hypermesh and hyperworks  framework using tcl scripting. This search tool has been added to new official version of HyperWorks

Skills gained:
Software: HyperWorks software
Solver: Optistruct
Programming: Tcl/Tk, C++

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description: Performed comprehensive data analysis to optimize power consumption in oil transportation. Actual power consumption of operating pumps was compared with the theoretical derived values and the cause of difference between these were studied and analyzed. Prepared a guide book for several combinations of flow through pipelines that optimizes power consumption and increases pump efficiency.

projects.title: 3D Topology Optimization Using Convolutional Neural Networks
projects.description:
•	Developed an 3d Encoder-Decoder Convolutional Neural Network as an alternative approach to conventional SIMP based topology optimization
•	Significantly reduced the running time of topology optimization, while maintaining high accuracy of final optimized structure
•	Proposed optimal computational strategy for practical development of the network to convert intermediate optimized structures to final optimized structures in any finite element topology optimization solver

projects.title: Mean Value Coordinates for closed Triangular Mesh
projects.description:
•	Implemented 3d mean value coordinates as summarized in ‘Mean Value Coordinates for Closed Triangular Meshes, Proceedings of SIGGRAPH 2005’ for applications in mesh deformation and volumetric color interpolation using C++ and OpenGL
•	Added various functionalities to modify mesh locally and globally using mean value coordinates
•	Developed an interactive GUI to modify mesh by picking and dragging control points
•	Implemented algorithm deforms the mesh smoothly and gives smooth interpolation of colors in the interior of the mesh using the values at the vertices of the mesh
